use default

alive(cells: string, index: int) -> bool =>
    index >= 0 /\ index < cells.length /\ cells[index] == '#'

live_neighbourhood(cells: string, index: int) -> int =>
    ((index - 1)::(index + 1))
        |> filter(at => alive(cells, at))
        |> count()

next_generation(cells: string) -> string =>
    (0..cells.length)
        |> map(index =>
            if live_neighbourhood(cells, index) == 2 then "#" else "_" fi)
        |> join("")

stream("_###_##_#_#_#_#__#__",
        generation => generation || next_generation(generation))
    |> take(10)
    |> each(generation => write_line(generation))

use default

alive(cells: string, index: int) -> bool =>
    index >= 0 /\ index < cells.length /\ cells[index] == '#'

live_neighbourhood(cells: string, index: int) -> int =>
    ((index - 1)::(index + 1))
        |> filter(at => alive(cells, at))
        |> count()

next_generation(cells: string) -> string =>
    (0..cells.length)
        |> map(index =>
            if live_neighbourhood(cells, index) == 2 then "#" else "_" fi)

stream("_###_##_#_#_#_#__#__",
